purpose: functional verification of machine conversations on KVM: a stand-in for each agent, and the real agents with no key when an image is given; no timing claim

cases.name: a conversation is made with nothing running; what cannot be is refused, with why

refused.a custom provider: no provider "custom" for a conversation: claude or codex
refused.no such provider: no provider "gpt" for a conversation: claude or codex
refused.a name already taken: machine talk-01 has a conversation named fix
refused.a name that is a number: a conversation's name is letters, digits, - and _, up to 63, and not a number
refused.a name with a slash: a conversation's name is letters, digits, - and _, up to 63, and not a number
refused.claude unattended as root: claude will not run unattended as root: give `user`, a user of the guest that is not
refused.from a conversation that is not there: machine talk-01 has no conversation absent to carry on from

cases.name: a message while a turn works goes into it: one process, one session, answered twice
a message after the turn ended starts a new one, resuming the session
the transcript is both sides, in order, from the agent's own events
an interrupt ends the running turn, and then there is none to interrupt
codex is a turn at a time: refused while one runs, and the next resumes its thread

detail.refused: turn 6 of this conversation is running, and codex takes no message while it does; interrupt it, or send this when it ends

cases.name: a conversation made from another gives the new agent what was said, both ways
conversations are listed, found by number or name, and deleted only when idle
an agent that ends before its first message is written says why

detail.branch: taken, and the turn ended saying why

cases.name: real agents: a machine from the image with both installed
real Claude Code: three messages answered in one session, the second into a turn if one ran
real Codex: the second turn resumes the first's thread
real agents: Codex is given what was said to Claude Code
